fix(watchers): a file watched by name is read by path, so only folders watched whole or as a tree subscribe fseventsd (brandon-unfiled-3248.iywk)

On macOS a directory watch is an FSEvents stream over the directory's whole
tree, and libuv drops all but direct children only after fseventsd has routed
each event here. The daemon heard named files (config candidates at project,
worktree and home roots, git's HEAD and index) through such watches, which made
it fseventsd's heaviest client.

A target that names its entries now opens no OS watch on any platform: one
sweep lstats every named path each second. One predicate on the target's shape
decides both the mechanism and what a stall deafens, so a file watched by name
carries no stall fault and the stall row names what it actually stops. The
probe watches its folder whole, since the stream is what it measures. Folder
identity stays in a watch's key only for OS-watched targets, derived in one
place for every consumer, git's spec included. daemon-stats shows polled names.

Also covers brandon-unfiled-3248.slsx (the stall row and the watch_file stall
fault).

chore(testing): the daemon-boot judge, ratchet and ceiling are deleted (candybar-testing-do00.cfu) (#749)

* chore(testing): the daemon-boot judge, ratchet and ceiling are deleted (candybar-testing-do00.cfu)

laws:testing counts a test that drives the daemon in process over fakes as a
unit test, so nothing judges where a daemon boots. The ratchet file and both
of its CI checks go, with the ledger preload, the global setup that installed
it, the harness's boot records and the teardown verdict. The tier configs that
pick files by directory stay.

* chore(testing): the judge's leftovers go: an unused import, the ledger kind, the one-caller preload merge (candybar-testing-do00.cfu)

The spawn helper's header stops claiming that no test can pass the daemon
ceiling, which nothing enforces; a daemon started through it counts against
the ceiling. withPreload folds into withStamp, its one caller.

* test(testing): the stamp test pins its preload to the stamp file, and the pool test's stand-in stops citing the ledger (candybar-testing-do00.cfu)
